resources.string: Isilawuli esintantayo se-Puzru. Isimo: %1$s. Izilawuli zokuvula/ukucisha, ukunweba nokuvala.

I-Puzru ayidingi i-akhawunti noma ukungena ngemvume futhi ayiceli imvume yemakrofoni. Ayithwebuli noma irekhode umsindo wemakrofoni, futhi ayirekhodi noma igcine izingxoxo zakho noma okuqukethwe kwazo komsindo.

I-Puzru isebenzisa ulwazi lwesistimu yomsindo ye-Android oludingekayo ekuqondiseni nasekuhloleni.

Ulwazi lokuhlola lwenziwa futhi lucutshungulwe kudivayisi yakho futhi lungaba sesimweni sendawo sohlelo olusebenzayo. Imibiko ayigcinwa noma ithunyelwe ngokuzenzakalela. Ukulondoloza umbiko noma ukuwudlulisela kolunye uhlelo lokusebenza kudinga isenzo sakho esicacile.
Ukukhetha ulimi ngaphakathi kwe-app kudinga i-Android 13 noma inguqulo entsha. Le divayisi ilandela ulimi lwesistimu.
Cisha isikrini uma ifoni iseduze nendlebe yakho

I-Puzru ye-Napahu Studios

Incazelo yegama
Igama elithi Puzru livela egameni lesi-Akkadian elihlobene nokufihla noma imfihlo. Libonisa injongo ye-app: ukunciphisa amathuba okuthi abantu abaseduze bezwe ukudlalwa kwezwi le-AI okusekelwayo.

Okwenziwa yi-Puzru
I-Puzru isiza ukuqondisa ukudlalwa kwezwi le-AI okusekelwayo kusamukeli sendlebe sezingcingo esakhelwe ngaphakathi kwefoni yakho, ukuze izimpendulo zizwakale njengasocingweni oluvamile kunokuba zidlalwe kakhulu ngesipikha esikhulu.

I-Puzru incike ezicini ezijwayelekile ze-Android zokuqondisa umsindo. Ukuhambisana kuncike kudivayisi yakho, enguqulweni ye-Android nasendleleni i-app noma isevisi ngayinye ephatha ngayo umsindo wezwi.

Ukuhambisana nemikhawulo
• Izici zezwi zisebenza ngezindlela ezihlukene kuma-app namasevisi ahlukene.
• Ezinye izindlela zezwi zingadinga ukubhalisa, zikhawulelwe ngesifunda noma nge-akhawunti, noma zingatholakali nhlobo.
• I-Puzru ayivuli, ayinwebi noma ayidluli izici ezinikezwa amasevisi ezinkampani zangaphandle.

Lokho i-Puzru engakwenzi
• Ayishayi izingcingo.
• Ayisebenzisi, ayishintshi noma ayilawuli amasevisi e-AI ezinkampani zangaphandle.
• Ayilawuli ukuqashelwa kwenkulumo, okuqukethwe noma ukunemba kwezimpendulo ze-AI, ukuphuma kwezwi, ukubambezeleka, ukuzinza kwenethiwekhi noma ukutholakala kwesevisi.
• Ayinikezi ubumfihlo kusevisi ye-AI ngokwayo. I-Puzru ishintsha indawo lapho umsindo wezwi osekelwayo udlalwa khona kudivayisi yakho, hhayi indlela isevisi ye-AI ephatha ngayo ingxoxo yakho.
Alukho uhlelo lokusebenza oluhambisanayo olungathumela lo mbiko.
Iseshini yomsindo iphele ngaphambi kokuba ukuqondiswa komsindo kuqedwe.
Isicelo sokuqondisa umsindo esipikheni sendlebe asamukelwanga.
